messages:
Marco: hi team, very new here. setting up a tiny PoC using hosted API keys and seeing 429s when I open 5 concurrent streaming tabs. is that normal for onboarding accounts?
DevEx: welcome Marco! sandbox and some early hosted tiers have low concurrency by default. 5 tabs could hit the concurrent-stream or requests/sec buckets.
Marco: how do i figure out which one exactly? the error body is just 429 right now.
Asha: check the response headers & JSON. we include a reason and retry hints. example we return on 429:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 1819002400
x-rw-retry-after: 1.4
{ "error": "rate_limited", "reason": "concurrent_streams" }
```
DevEx: if you see reason: tokens_per_min then it's token budget. requests_per_min or concurrent_streams are other common ones. some orgs also have separate embedding quotas (x-rw-embed-* headers).
Marco: im also using ephemeral CI tokens for a small demo runner. do they have same quotas as long-lived hosted keys?
Asha: ephemeral tokens usually inherit the quota of the org/project they belong to. they don't bypass limits. best practice: use an org demo key with a short-lived boost for demos, or request a devex sandbox bump.
Marco: cool. can i request a bump and how long does it take?
DevEx: for sandbox we can often enable a 24-48h boost the same day if you give name, team, and time window. for hosted quota increases it's via Console -> Account -> Quotas (admins) and takes longer. if you share the demo time window here we can pre-authorize.
Marco: demo tomorrow 2pm-3pm PT, single presenter. can you enable for that window?
DevEx: sure. creating a devex temporary boost now. InfraBot: devex-boost-ticket created (ID: DX-2104) for Marco, window 2025-03-11T14:00-15:00 PT.
Ben: quick tips to avoid 429s even without a boost: reuse one streaming connection and multiplex logical sessions over it, trim prompt history, cap max_tokens, and add exp backoff on 429 (base 300ms, cap 5s, jitter).
Marco: got it. any quick code pattern for multiplexing?
Asha: simple approach: single websocket/stream, prefix messages with session_id, server-side route routes to different chat contexts. reduces active TCP/ws connections.
Marco: last q: embeddings vs chat  do embeddings consume the same tokens/min quota?
DevEx: depends on org config. many orgs share tokens/min; some tiers separate embedding usage. check headers for embedding-specific counters. when in doubt assume shared.
Marco: perfect, thanks all. i'll try multiplexing and follow up if the devex boost isn't enough. :)
